name: meta-2026-11-03-net128
description: The same 1 November jury and lists, rerun with the current bot (net_128, trained on 1,600-game iterations with the matchup panel) to compare the simulated matchups with real players' win rates (lab/meta/riftdecks_winrate_2026-11-03.json, lab/tools/compare_matrix.py). With net_038 the Riven lists beat Kennen 78-88% against 46% for real players.
